llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: promises of guaranteed and extremely high returns (up to 80%), vague company details, newly registered domain (Feb 2025) with suspicious registrant information (individual, free email, Nigerian address), exclusive reliance on cryptocurrency for payments/deposits, unverifiable testimonials, excessive urgency/instant action messaging, ambiguous privacy/export policy, and no evidence of regulatory approvals. Domain uses suspended nameservers, further indicating untrustworthiness. These are textbook signs of a fraudulent investment/crypto scheme.
